en.headline: Hong Kong Cyclothon returns 11 October with new five-tunnel three-bridge route
en.dek: Registration for the 56 km and 32 km public rides opens on 20 August; the event will again feature a UCI 1.1 road race and a family carnival at West Kowloon Cultural District.
body: The Sun Hung Kai Properties Hong Kong Cyclothon will take place on 11 October, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said, with online registration for the public rides opening at 10 a.m. on 20 August.

The 56 km ride introduces a new ‘five tunnels and three bridges’ route that includes the Central Kowloon Route for the first time, while both the 56 km and 32 km non-competitive rides start and finish at West Kowloon Cultural District. More than 6,500 places are available across the two public events.

The day will also feature a UCI 1.1-level professional road race covering about 100 km through Yau Tsim Mong, Sham Shui Po, Kwai Tsing and Kowloon City, plus a family cycling activity and a carnival at the cultural district. The Tourism Board said the upgraded routes and harbourfront finish aim to showcase more of the city’s landscape to local and overseas cyclists.

zh.headline: 香港單車節10月11日舉行 推「五隧三橋」路線
zh.dek: 56公里組及32公里組公眾騎行項目8月20日起接受網上報名，起點及終點設於西九文化區，並再次上演國際單車聯盟1.1級公路賽。
body: 香港旅遊發展局宣布，「新鴻基地產香港單車節」將於10月11日舉行，56公里組及32公里組兩項非競賽公眾騎行項目於8月20日上午10時起接受網上報名。
56公里組推出全新「五隧三橋」路線，首次開放中九龍繞道予單車活動；兩項公眾項目起點及終點均設於西九文化區，合共提供逾6500個名額。
當日亦會舉行國際單車聯盟1.1級公路賽，全程約100公里，途經油尖旺、深水埗、葵青及九龍城等區，並設家庭單車活動及西九嘉年華。旅發局表示，升級路線及海濱終點旨在讓本地及海外單車愛好者體驗更多香港城市景觀。
